name: websearch
description: Multi-engine web search for ZCode as a zero-dependency MCP server: AnySearch, Exa, Parallel, Bing and SearXNG chained with automatic fallback, plus a static page reader. Every engine works without a key; filling one in switches it to your own quota. Configuration (engine order, per-engine keys) is websearch.json inside the plugin data folder — created automatically on first use, and the tools report its exact path, so just ask the model for the websearch config location.

description_i18n.en: Multi-engine web search for ZCode as a zero-dependency MCP server: AnySearch, Exa, Parallel, Bing and SearXNG chained with automatic fallback, plus a static page reader. Every engine works without a key; filling one in switches it to your own quota. Configuration (engine order, per-engine keys) is websearch.json inside the plugin data folder — created automatically on first use, and the tools report its exact path, so just ask the model for the websearch config location.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 独立网页搜索：零依赖 MCP server，AnySearch / Exa / Parallel / Bing / SearXNG 自动回退，另带静态网页正文读取；所有引擎免 Key 可用。配置（引擎顺序、各引擎 Key）写在插件数据目录的 websearch.json——首次使用自动生成，装好后直接问模型「websearch 配置在哪」即可拿到具体路径。

order.title: Engine order
order.description: Comma-separated engine ids tried in order: anysearch / exa / parallel / bing / searxng

disabled.title: Disabled engines
disabled.description: Comma-separated engine ids to skip, e.g. exa,searxng; empty keeps all enabled

mode.title: Retry mode
mode.description: fallback = start from the first engine every call; rotate = shift the start by one each call to spread free tiers

limit.title: Default result count
limit.description: 1-10, used when a tool call omits limit

timeout_ms.title: Total timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: One deadline covers the whole chain, 5000-60000; each engine gets the remaining budget

bing_market.title: Bing market
bing_market.description: auto = follow the query language; or fix it to zh / en

searxng_instances.title: SearXNG instances
searxng_instances.description: One base URL per line, JSON API required; empty skips the engine

anysearch_key.title: AnySearch key (optional)
anysearch_key.description: Empty uses the free tier; filling it in switches the engine to your own quota (Authorization: Bearer)

exa_key.title: Exa key (optional)
exa_key.description: Empty uses the anonymous tier; filling it in switches the engine to your own quota (Authorization: Bearer)

parallel_key.title: Parallel key (optional)
parallel_key.description: Empty uses the anonymous tier; filling it in switches the engine to your own quota (x-api-key)
